title: GEMglTexGenfv
description: control the generation of texture coordinates

messages.description: symbolic name of the texture-coordinate generation function
list of values for the texture generation parameter

arguments.description: symbolic name of the texture-coordinate generation function

body: [GEMglTexGenfv] calls glTexGenfv() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. GL constants are numbers here: [GLdefine] turns a name like GL_LINES into its value. See glTexGen in the OpenGL reference.
